My expertise spans Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, and GCP, with a deep focus on distributed systems, microservices, and AI-driven automation.

Enhanced monitoring & logging with Dynatrace & Splunk, improving system reliability.
Automated infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, Helm & GitHub Actions.
